summary: centralize code2llm artifact candidate paths in scan

delivery.outcome: Remove the code2llm `Shotgun Surgery: candidates` smell (planfile PLF-044) from src/koru/scan.py: mutation of `candidates` spanned 6 functions. The six hand-written `candidates` tuples plus inline `next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)` probes (_find_analysis_file, _code2llm_cc_locations, _code2llm_module_paths, _merge_call_graph_locations, _planfile_dup_groups_are_extern_mirrors, _should_skip_code2llm_dup_ticket) are replaced by three module constants (_ANALYSIS_ARTIFACT_PATHS, _PLANFILE_TICKETS_ARTIFACT_PATHS, _CALLS_ARTIFACT_PATHS; relative probe locations, most preferred first) with resolution routed through the pre-existing _first_existing_artifact helper. _load_yaml_mapping now takes (project, rel_paths) and resolves internally instead of accepting pre-built absolute candidates. Changing where a code2llm artifact is probed is now one constant edit instead of edits scattered across six functions. Probe tuples keep the exact previous order and membership — including the analysis order where the nested plain-text project/analysis.toon beats a repo-root analysis.toon.yaml copy, which no naive per-name nested-then-root expansion would preserve — so behavior is unchanged; a new regression test pins that order. No public surface changes: only private helpers and module constants are touched, and no consumer module is modified.
nonGoals: Changing which files are probed or the probe priority order
Deduplicating the double planfile-tickets.yaml load inside _should_skip_code2llm_dup_ticket (pre-existing behavior kept verbatim)
Touching the separate candidates parameter of the suggestion-building cluster around _first_existing_artifact call sites
Reformatting pre-existing ruff format drift in tests/test_scan.py
Refactoring any other module flagged by code2llm

architecture.decision: Three frozen tuples of repo-relative probe paths plus the pre-existing _first_existing_artifact resolver replace six hand-built absolute-path tuples. _find_analysis_file returns the resolver's (path, rel) pair directly (the relative string equals the old str(path.relative_to(project))); _load_yaml_mapping takes (project, rel_paths) and keeps its tolerant yaml loading (missing file or non-mapping payload yields None). The artifact-location knowledge now lives in exactly one place per artifact, so the shotgun-surgery driver — the same variable mutated across six functions — is gone: `candidates` remains only as _first_existing_artifact's own parameter. No patch-target audit surface changes: tests reference the helpers by name and those names are unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore the six inline candidates tuples and the absolute-path _load_yaml_mapping signature.
